name: Infinitii Ai Inc.
summary: infinitii ai inc. engages in the provision of artificial intelligence driven predictive analytics in Canada and the United States. The company offers predictive analytics software for smart city and smart industry infrastructure operations, such as automated water system inflow and infiltration, predictive combined sewage overflow, and streaming analytics for data transformation. Its product, infinitii flowworks, provides environmental monitoring to water utilities through direct sales and partner network of engineering and IT services companies. The company was formerly known as Carl Data Solutions Inc. and changed its name to infinitii ai inc. in October 2022. infinitii ai inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
